topic: Capstone Data Pipeline and Backend Integration
learningObjectives: Design a data pipeline from input collection to model prediction.
Connect preprocessing and model components with a backend service.
Identify how data flows between the frontend, backend, and AI model.

activities.title: Map the AI Data Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the pipeline stages in the correct order.

content.concept: A typical AI pipeline moves through data collection, validation, preprocessing, inference, and response.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Pipeline Component Map
activities.instruction: Explore each component and its role in the AI pipeline.

content.concept: Data loaders, preprocessors, models, and APIs each perform distinct responsibilities in an AI system.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Reads data from a source such as a file, database, sensor, or request.
Checks whether incoming data is valid, complete, and within expected ranges.
Cleans and transforms raw data into a usable representation.
Converts processed data into the feature format expected by the model.
Uses learned parameters to produce a prediction or generated output.
Receives client requests and coordinates the AI processing workflow.
Formats the model result and sends the response back to the client.

activities.title: Build the Backend Flow
activities.instruction: Assemble the backend components into one AI prediction flow.

content.concept: An AI backend accepts input, validates it, prepares features, runs inference, and returns predictions.
